Google TV and many Android TV devices only offer their own screensaver in Settings. Run these commands once from a computer with ADB (developer options and USB or network debugging on). The first line lets this app change the setting itself; after it, Set as screensaver works here. The last number is the delay in milliseconds; it must be shorter than the time after which this device goes to sleep, or the screensaver never starts.

adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %2$s
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_enabled 1
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_activate_on_sleep 1
adb shell settings put system screen_off_timeout %3$s

Options
End the screensaver after Art Mode starts

Off by default. Normally the TV puts this device to sleep over HDMI-CEC once Art Mode is on. If this device stays awake, this ends the screensaver after a delay. Ending it lets the device go to sleep by itself, and over HDMI-CEC that can turn the TV off or switch its input instead of leaving it in Art Mode.
Delay: %1$s
End the screensaver after
Power-key fallback

Off by default. When the TV\'s Art Mode service cannot be reached, or refuses the request with an error other than the Art Store terms, send one power-key press over the TV\'s remote-control channel, after checking again that the TV reports that it is on. Nothing is pressed when the TV did not answer in time, refused access, or may already have switched. On The Frame a press toggles between TV and Art Mode, and without its Art Mode service the app cannot see which one the TV shows: if it already shows art, the press switches it back to TV. The TV has to allow this app once.
Allow remote control on the TV
